accountView.title: Microsoft account
accountView.signInHint: Sign-in opens your web browser. The launcher never sees your password; it only receives a sign-in code from Microsoft.

typeHints.snapshot: Test versions before a release. They can damage worlds; keep copies of worlds you care about.
typeHints.old_beta: Beta versions from 2010–2011. They run on Java 8 and have no demo mode, so playing needs a signed-in account.
typeHints.old_alpha: Alpha, Classic and pre-Classic versions from 2009–2010. They run on Java 8 and have no demo mode, so playing needs a signed-in account.

createForm.isolation: Each installation gets its own game folder for worlds, options and screenshots. The version cannot be changed later; create another installation to play a different version.
createForm.stale: Showing the last saved catalog because it could not be refreshed.
createForm.planRuntimeUnknown: Determined when the runtime is prepared

harness.title: Lifecycle test (debug build only)
harness.explanation: Starts a harmless copy of this launcher as a child process to test closing and reopening the window. It cannot run any other program and is not part of release builds.

quit.dialogBody: Quitting now would stop it. Stopping a game may lose unsaved progress. You can keep the launcher running in the background instead; open it again to return.
quit.jobTitle: Game files are still being prepared
quit.jobBody: Quitting now cancels the installation or repair; files verified so far are kept for next time. Keep it running in the background and the launcher window returns when it finishes.

console.title: Console
console.openHint: Everything the launcher does and everything the game prints, live, in a separate window (Ctrl+Shift+L).
console.empty: Nothing yet. Install or start a game to see its output here.
console.count: {shown, number} of {total, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}
console.missed: {count, plural, one {# older line was} other {# older lines were}} dropped (the console keeps the newest 10,000).
console.unreachable: The launcher core does not answer. Lines will appear again when it does.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.exportExplanation: Creates a ZIP file you can attach to a support request. It contains launcher and system information, installation versions and health, recent operation results and the launcher-captured output of the last three runs. Home and launcher folder paths are shortened and sign-in tokens are removed.
diagnostics.exportExcluded: Never included: account records, sign-in tokens, launch argument files, worlds, screenshots, options or other files from game folders.

foundation.title: Project status
foundation.body: Installing, repairing and launching are implemented. Starting the game needs Microsoft sign-in, which this build cannot offer until the project supplies its own Microsoft application ID.
